name: Cutout.free
tagline: Remove image backgrounds and download transparent PNGs without an account
description:
Cutout.free is a free browser-based background remover for portraits, products, pets and everyday objects. Select a JPG, PNG or WebP image, review the cutout, and download a transparent PNG or a JPG with a background. You can replace the background with a solid color or another image, then compare edges before saving.

The online tool works in current desktop and mobile browsers without an account, usage credits or a daily allowance. Uploads support files up to 20 MB. It is useful for product listings, profile pictures, presentations and other designs that need an isolated subject. Results depend on the source photo, so users should inspect fine details before exporting. The linked ClapClip Windows app is a separate product with additional AI features.
